decision_rationale: The record describes a new multimodal framework, scMMGPT, with a two-stage pre-training strategy and explicit generative objectives. It is trained at scale on 60 million single-cell profiles plus cell descriptions, supporting foundation-model-like breadth and transfer.
evidence_snippet: "two-stage pre-training strategy combining discriminative precision with generative flexibility"; "60 million single-cell profiles"; "enable bidirectional cell-text generation"
